programmes.d: Under the main building of Dorchester Shire Hall there is a warren of tunnels and cells. Stuart enters this area that is said to house many a phantom.
The history of York Castle Museum is almost endless as are the paranormal stories attached to it. Karl enters the street and cells with dramatic effect.
Yvette takes Karl, Stuart and Mary into the vast Shrewsbury Prison. A place riddled with paranormal activity of every kind.
Yvette and Glen: Built on ancient ground, Hack Green Nuclear Bunker is a hot spot for paranormal activity. Yvette and Glen go it alone and soon experience the bunkers reputation first-hand.
HMP Gloucester is a houses a huge selection of buildings, Karl investigates one block where spirits are said to make themselves known on a regular basis.
The education block of HMP Gloucester is an eerie set of corridors and empty rooms. Stuart enters for the first time and gradually realises that something is there with him.
Karl ventures, alone, to the upper floors of this large mansion and id stalked by something that wants to be heard.
Gregg enters the bunker for the first time and feels its energy. Has he caught the voice of the mysterious woman that some believe was murdered there?
Once a prison camp during WWII, Eden Camp is now a museum housing many an artefact and many a ghost. Karl enters the cottage to face the spirits that are said to haunt this once family home.
Once a grand mansion, this huge property is now very much passed it previous grandeur. Stuart investigates the long empty corridors alone and something seems to be following him.
Karl and Stuart head to Hack Green Bunker and witness, first hand, the paranormal activity that regularly occurs there.
Karl investigates Carlton house library for the first time and quickly realises that he is not alone.
Karl enters Borwick Hall for the first time as he investigates the upper floors.
Our investigation into Borwick Hall continues as Stuart investigates the middle floors.

programmes.d: Ready for a ghost puppy? When the animals in a Missouri house start acting strange, a man captures a paranormal animal on video. Plus, a lighthouse that once served as a quarantined home for cholera sufferers is haunted.

An angry witch's ghost stirs up violent storms and tumultuous events. The spirits of former teachers and students haunt an abandoned schoolhouse. A man on the verge of suicide finds inspiration when a supernatural purple light appears.
A terrifying seven-foot-tall shadow figure named "Mr. Black" haunts an abandoned hospital. A building is haunted by the spirit of a man whose head was severed by the building.
The Lyceum Theatre in Crewe is known for its paranormal activity and in this episode the team take the fight right to phantoms that lurk in its darkness with some frightening consequences.
The ghost of a drowned soldier awaits Yvette and her team of paranormal experts as they tackle the hauntings that plague this once magnificent castle.
Nestled into the British countryside is Halsham house where a poltergeist hides in wait for the team with frightening effect. With bones found in the attic have the team pushed it too far.

Yvette takes her fearless team to a onetime house, onetime museum and now a care home to investigate the strange goings on reported by staff and guests alike. It doesn’t take long for Yvette to regret her decision to go it alone in the cold dark cellar.
The Most Haunted team visit a gem in the Cheshire countryside where a disembodied voice brings disarray to the investigation and something in the cellar fills Yvette with fear and dread.

Yvette takes her team to Oak House, said to be one of the most haunted places in West Bromwich. Fear and fright take hold when something seems to follow them and one experience changes the belief of both Glen and Karl.
Yvette and her team are called to a grade II listed building that spans over 900 years in an attempt to uncover the mysterious paranormal activity that is said to occur there.
Yvette Fielding and her team take on their biggest challenge yet in a prison where many have lost their lives and some seem to have remained.

Part two of this mammoth investigation takes the team to the condemned cell and execution room. Is it a hangman or one of the executed souls that makes itself present and causes the team to re-evaluate what they are doing.
